title: MVSeg2023 mitral valve segmentation challenge
role: valve donors for the semi-synthetic paired benchmark; TEE component evaluation

license.name: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
consequences_for_this_project: NoDerivatives is stricter than ACDC's ShareAlike. A leaflet donor fitted to the frozen topology is a derivative work, so fitted valve meshes and any semi-synthetic benchmark built from them cannot be redistributed at all, not merely under a matching licence.
Using the data to fit, train and evaluate internally is unaffected; it is distribution that ND blocks.

A public benchmark release therefore cannot include the valve side. Section 6.3 WP8 of the specification anticipates releasing a paired benchmark; with this licence that is not possible for MVSeg2023-derived donors, and the plan needs amending rather than discovering this at release.
Combined with ACDC's non-commercial ShareAlike, no derived artefact of this project can go out under the repository's MIT terms.

limitations: Single-frame volumes: no full-cycle valve motion, so temporal claims cannot rest on this dataset.
Leaflets only; no annulus curve or chamber context is labelled.
